storyline.real: Vettel starts from pole and stops twice; Hamilton, on three stops, catches him late on fresher tyres, passes him and wins by 5.2 s.
storyline.headline: Vettel's two stops hold off Hamilton in Shanghai

eras.briefing: Shanghai, 2011. Vettel starts from pole, Button second and Hamilton third. You run Vettel, third after ten laps and 1.8 s behind Button in the lead. Win it.
